intent: rebuild modular kits from wall design references

themes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D side-view Unity pixel-art sprite KIT atlas.
Reference image role: the reference defines THIS stage's exact wall material, palette and architectural identity. Rebuild a practical matching tile kit, keep its recognizable design, simplify only joins for seamless assembly. Do NOT draw a gameplay screenshot.
Canvas/layout: 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 separately isolated sprites on genuine transparent alpha. Equal cells and generous clear gutters at least 10% cell width. Landscape 4:3 atlas. Nothing crosses cell borders. No lettering, labels, guide lines or background.
Reading order MUST be:
ROW1: (1) left-wall TOP CAP, narrow upright, no inward walkway; (2) left-wall REPEAT BODY, narrow upright plain flat-cut matching sockets on top and bottom; (3) left-wall FOOT, narrow upright; (4) BROKEN wall body, upright with a large truly transparent opening in middle but matching sockets at both ends.
ROW2: (5) NORMAL horizontal platform, rough/grippy top; (6) SLIPPERY horizontal platform, perfectly level smooth polished top with long bright DOUBLE reflection stripes, obvious slippery material; (7) CRUMBLING platform, cracked/separated slabs and damaged support; (8) CLOUD/GHOST platform, materialized translucent-looking pale segments with clear solid top and airy gaps below.
ROW3: (9) MOVING horizontal platform with mechanical underside and tiny opposing geometric chevrons; (10) TRAMPOLINE horizontal elastic pad with visible springs under it; (11) PORTAL upright ring/arched frame with empty alpha center and little accent-color inner rim; (12) LADDER upright, clearly spaced rungs and slim material-matched side rails.
ROW4: (13) JOINT COLLAR, short solid horizontal crossbar/band to overlay and completely conceal mismatched wall splice lines; (14) dark decorative interior WINDOW/ARCH upright; (15) ROPE ANCHOR bracket with short hanging cord and ring; (16) SUMMIT/GOAL platform, horizontal with same stable top, small edge accent only.
Tile geometry: wall bodies (1-4) are straight columns, overall height 2.4 times width. No cap/finial on repeat body: its top and bottom are IDENTICAL plain end faces; trim details, windows, gears NEVER cross these cut edges. Uniform wall outer spine width and socket arrangement across all pieces. The collar is wider than the body and in the same material, with a flat functional bolted/stone joint appearance. Top/foot decorative ends only at actual end of assembled wall. Right wall is obtained by mirroring these left modules in Unity.
Platforms (5-10,16): broad shallow front-facing rectangles, aspect approximately 5:1, perfectly horizontal straight top silhouette at the same cell height. Thickness is compact, no tall towers/feet beneath them. Show front face only, not isometric top plane. Slip and normal must be distinguishable in GRAYSCALE: long smooth continuous double highlights versus rough segmented top.
Pixel style: intentionally coarse crisp 1990s 16-bit pixel game sprites, simple readable 32-64 logical pixel clusters per object, nearest-neighbor enlarged square pixels, thick dark outlines, limited 3-tone ramps, large purposeful shapes. Match the chunky stout human sprite scale from the project. No photorealism, no painterly brushwork, no 3D render, no soft bloom, no anti-aliased vector lines. No grass, earth, plants, scenery, cast shadows, floor plane, extra characters, watermark or solid black background. Preserve true alpha in all gutters and openings.
Specific theme below:
Wall architecture and materials: ivory ABS keycaps, charcoal switch housings, orange tracks, lime status lights; crisp clean chunky classic computer castle.
Normal platform must read as 무광 ABS 스페이스 키. Slippery platform must read as UV 코팅 광택 키캡; keep the same stage's supporting material underneath. Every gimmick uses the same architecture, palette and connectors. Use small '#ff7b18' accent details with deep '#343848' outlines, not a generic blue ice block.
Make a clean readable game asset atlas with all 16 pieces.

Canvas/layout: 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 separately isolated sprites on genuine transparent alpha. Equal cells and generous clear gutters at least 10% cell width. Landscape 4:3 atlas. Nothing crosses cell borders. No lettering, labels, guide lines or background.
Reading order MUST be:
ROW1: (1) left-wall TOP CAP, narrow upright, no inward walkway; (2) left-wall REPEAT BODY, narrow upright plain flat-cut matching sockets on top and bottom; (3) left-wall FOOT, narrow upright; (4) BROKEN wall body, upright with a large truly transparent opening in middle but matching sockets at both ends.
ROW2: (5) NORMAL horizontal platform, rough/grippy top; (6) SLIPPERY horizontal platform, perfectly level smooth polished top with long bright DOUBLE reflection stripes, obvious slippery material; (7) CRUMBLING platform, cracked/separated slabs and damaged support; (8) CLOUD/GHOST platform, materialized translucent-looking pale segments with clear solid top and airy gaps below.
ROW3: (9) MOVING horizontal platform with mechanical underside and tiny opposing geometric chevrons; (10) TRAMPOLINE horizontal elastic pad with visible springs under it; (11) PORTAL upright ring/arched frame with empty alpha center and little accent-color inner rim; (12) LADDER upright, clearly spaced rungs and slim material-matched side rails.
ROW4: (13) JOINT COLLAR, short solid horizontal crossbar/band to overlay and completely conceal mismatched wall splice lines; (14) dark decorative interior WINDOW/ARCH upright; (15) ROPE ANCHOR bracket with short hanging cord and ring; (16) SUMMIT/GOAL platform, horizontal with same stable top, small edge accent only.
Tile geometry: wall bodies (1-4) are straight columns, overall height 2.4 times width. No cap/finial on repeat body: its top and bottom are IDENTICAL plain end faces; trim details, windows, gears NEVER cross these cut edges. Uniform wall outer spine width and socket arrangement across all pieces. The collar is wider than the body and in the same material, with a flat functional bolted/stone joint appearance. Top/foot decorative ends only at actual end of assembled wall. Right wall is obtained by mirroring these left modules in Unity.
Platforms (5-10,16): broad shallow front-facing rectangles, aspect approximately 5:1, perfectly horizontal straight top silhouette at the same cell height. Thickness is compact, no tall towers/feet beneath them. Show front face only, not isometric top plane. Slip and normal must be distinguishable in GRAYSCALE: long smooth continuous double highlights versus rough segmented top.
Pixel style: intentionally coarse crisp 1990s 16-bit pixel game sprites, simple readable 32-64 logical pixel clusters per object, nearest-neighbor enlarged square pixels, thick dark outlines, limited 3-tone ramps, large purposeful shapes. Match the chunky stout human sprite scale from the project. No photorealism, no painterly brushwork, no 3D render, no soft bloom, no anti-aliased vector lines. No grass, earth, plants, scenery, cast shadows, floor plane, extra characters, watermark or solid black background. Preserve true alpha in all gutters and openings.
Specific theme below:
Wall architecture and materials: dark grey large mechanical keycaps, fuchsia and cyan RGB traces, strong square key silhouettes with few plus marks, keyboard castle not server panels.
Normal platform must read as 검은 키캡과 빗금 고무. Slippery platform must read as 유광 검은 키캡; keep the same stage's supporting material underneath. Every gimmick uses the same architecture, palette and connectors. Use small '#ed49ad' accent details with deep '#202840' outlines, not a generic blue ice block.
